title: When I read the Bible, it feels like I am there witnessing the moment…
paragraphs: When I read the Bible, it feels like I am there witnessing the moment…
The air is heavy. Voices rise. Compassion fades into tension. Scripture says the earth was filled with violence—not just in action, but in the human heart.
Standing at the edge of it all… I feel the sorrow of what happens when humanity drifts away from God.
It didn’t happen suddenly. It rarely does.
Little compromises… quiet hardening… truth slowly bending… until love is replaced with conflict.
He saw the brokenness. He saw the grief. He saw the few who still chose righteousness in a collapsing world.
Because even when culture shifts… God remains steady.

And maybe faithfulness begins in the quiet decisions no one sees—
how I speak… how I love… how I respond… how I stand.
So as I witness this moment… I ask myself:

Will I drift with the world…
or will I walk steady with God?
